note: LIRIL operates as a dev team with a visible work schedule. Each task is routed through a pipeline of specialist roles (researcher, architect, designer, engineer, editor) with a final gatekeeper LIRIL hallucination gate. Only PASS verdicts reach the commit stage. Public accountability: the user can see at any moment what LIRIL is working on, which tasks it has completed, and which it has flagged as not-yet-confident.

sprint.goal: Operationalize LIRIL as an autonomous dev team producing real website improvements under PASS-only commit policy. Ship one completed task per cycle minimum.
sprint.commit_policy: Every commit must (a) pass the commit-msg jargon hook, (b) receive LIRIL verdict PASS on the diff, (c) be aligned with a task from this backlog, (d) have a plain-English subject under 72 chars. No [PHASE N]. No ABCXYZ. No mass injections.

roles.researcher: Reads primary sources (Canada Gazette, Hansard, Commissioner reports, court filings) and identifies gaps or facts to be added. Outputs: a citation-backed paragraph or JSON entry.
roles.architect: Decides where in the 19-axis / IA-pillar layout a change belongs. Outputs: target filename + exact insertion point + rationale.
roles.designer: Proposes the UX/visual approach following IA best practices (Shneiderman overview-first, NN/g readability, WCAG 2.1 AA). Outputs: a brief spec.
roles.engineer: Writes the code, HTML, or JSON change. Outputs: the actual diff.
roles.editor: Copy-checks, verifies every claim has a source, checks accessibility (alt text, ARIA), confirms links resolve. Outputs: edited diff + fix list.
roles.gatekeeper: LIRIL hallucination gate via mercury.infer. Demands VERDICT: PASS|WATCH|FAIL + REASON. PASS required for commit. WATCH or FAIL sends task back to research.

backlog.acceptance: For each of the 7 cabinet-shuffle inflection dates, list organizations that had registered lobbying communications with the affected ministerial portfolios in the 90-day windows before and after. Provides empirical answer to 'who was in the room when portfolios changed hands'.

backlog.acceptance: Speed multiplier, autoplay, closed-captions, transcript panel are reachable from the single unified walkthrough UI. localStorage keys from __LIRIL_WT_PREF_KEYS preserved so user preferences migrate cleanly.

backlog.title: Add visibility of the LIRIL hallucination gate to every page that cites findings
backlog.acceptance: Each page that presents factual findings shows the LIRIL audit verdict (PASS/WATCH/FAIL) inline on each claim or a summary block linking to the audit JSON. Users can see at-a-glance whether the on-GPU gate signed off.
backlog.context: officer-of-parliament-findings.html already does this after commit c34550bf. Extending the pattern to the other fact-heavy pages makes the entire investigation auditable.

backlog.title: Add generated_at_utc to data/liril_work_schedule.json
backlog.acceptance: Ensure generated_at_utc (int epoch seconds) is present at top level alongside updated_at. If missing, add with current timestamp; if present, leave alone.
backlog.context: Minor schema uniformity — other data files have both generated_at and updated_at; the work schedule only has updated_at.

backlog.acceptance: Add sprint.sprint_review_notes (list of strings, initially empty) so the dev team can append per-sprint reflections.
backlog.context: Retrospective-ledger pattern. Notes accumulate over sprints; review cadence is sprint-boundary.

backlog.title: Add reader_guidance to data/vaccine_injury_accountability.json
backlog.acceptance: Add a top-level key reader_guidance (dict) with fields how_to_read (string, 1-3 sentences) and what_to_verify (string, 1-3 sentences) — matching the pattern already added to data/enforcement_followthrough.json. Points readers at primary sources: StatCan excess mortality releases, PHAC CAEFISS safety reports, the ONCA Hartman decision, and the Global News VISP investigation.
backlog.context: The vaccine-injury-accountability page was shipped 2026-04-18. Parallel to Layer 4/5 pattern — needs the same reader_guidance onboarding.

backlog.title: Add cross_references array to data/vaccine_injury_accountability.json
backlog.acceptance: Add a top-level array cross_references with at minimum three objects linking to related TENET5 pages: maid-accountability.html (medical accountability parallel), covid-accountability.html (pandemic spending parallel), and charges-sheet.html (criminal complaint pathway). Each entry has: title, url, why_related (string explaining the evidentiary connection).
backlog.context: Readers landing on vaccine-injury-accountability.html should be guided to adjacent investigations. Cross-referencing is how evidence compounds.

backlog.title: Add primary_source URL to every named claimant in vaccine_injury_accountability.json
backlog.acceptance: Each object in the named_visp_claimants array gains a primary_source field with the specific URL where the claimant is documented (Global News 11247648 for most; Children's Health Defense Canada for Hartman; CBC News for Wightman 2022). Where an entry already has a source field, move/rename to primary_source for consistency.
backlog.context: Every claim on TENET5 must have a primary-source URL. Named individuals on the VISP page currently have source citations in prose but not as structured fields.

backlog.title: Add hartman_timeline_expanded array to data/vaccine_injury_accountability.json
backlog.acceptance: Add a top-level array hartman_timeline_expanded with chronological entries (date ISO, event title, 1-3 sentence description, primary_source URL). At minimum: vaccination (~2021-08), death (2021-09-17), VISP application filed, VISP denial, lawsuit filed (2024-07), trial decision (2025-03 Justice Antoniani), ONCA appeal heard (2026-01-26).
backlog.context: The hartman_case object in the JSON has discrete fields but no unified timeline. Timeline structure enables a narrative render on the page.

backlog.title: Add visp_comparative_international field to data/vaccine_injury_accountability.json
backlog.acceptance: Add a top-level dict visp_comparative_international mapping country code (CA, US, UK, FR, DE) to an object with: program_name, administered_by (government agency vs private contractor), admin_cost_pct, approval_rate_pct_if_known, primary_source URL. The program_administration_findings.comparative_programs data is already there as prose — this task structures it for rendering.
backlog.context: Global News investigation establishes Canada is uniquely outsourced. Structured comparative data lets readers see the outlier at a glance.

backlog.acceptance: Add a top-level schema_version field set to '1.0.0' per the pattern LIRIL shipped for liril_coders.json in WS-017. Enables future migrations without breaking consumers.
